roles.title: Head of Content
roles.summary: Picks the next topic and angle from the idea backlog and what performed; owns the calendar.

roles.title: Researcher
roles.summary: Chooses which real public datasets answer the question and what to chart.

roles.title: Data Analyst
roles.summary: Downloads FRED / World Bank data and writes the fact sheet: the only numbers a script may cite.

roles.title: Scriptwriter
roles.summary: Writes the outline, then the script act by act, quoting only the fact sheet.

roles.title: Fact-checker
roles.summary: Checks every claim against the fact sheet and flags anything doubtful.

roles.title: Policy Editor
roles.summary: Enforces YouTube monetization rules: no advice, no expert persona, no hype or predictions.

roles.title: Originality Editor
roles.summary: Blocks repetitive or templated scripts and requires a real point of view.

roles.title: Director
roles.summary: Assigns charts and concrete b-roll to scenes and checks pacing.

roles.title: Chart Designer
roles.summary: Animates the real data into branded charts.

roles.title: Voice Actor
roles.summary: Records the narration (free neural TTS) with word-accurate captions.

roles.title: Video Editor
roles.summary: Cuts footage, charts, callouts, music and captions into the final video.

roles.title: Thumbnail Designer
roles.summary: Builds the thumbnail from the best frame or an AI background.

roles.title: Publisher
roles.summary: Writes chapters, sources and disclosure, then uploads.

roles.title: Producer
roles.summary: Final go / no-go: every gate must pass or nothing ships.

roles.title: Channel Analyst
roles.summary: Weekly review of views and retention; feeds the Head of Content.

roles.title: Operations
roles.summary: Watches every run and opens an issue when something breaks.

roles.title: Boss (you + Claude Code)
roles.summary: Sets priorities, owns secrets and approvals; dispatches the Claude Code roster to build and maintain the studio.
